items.source: Abstractions for reactive HTTP server support including a ServerHttpRequest and ServerHttpResponse along with an HttpHandler for processing.
items.translation: 对响应式 HTTP 服务器支持提供的抽象，包括一个 `ServerHttpRequest` 和一个 `ServerHttpResponse`，以及一个用于处理的 `HttpHandler`。

items.source: Provides implementations of Encoder and Decoder for web use.
items.translation: 为 Web 用途提供Encoder和Decoder的实现。

items.source: Implementations to adapt to the underlying org.springframework.http.client.reactive reactive HTTP adapter and HttpHandler.
items.translation: 用于适配底层 `org.springframework.http.client.reactive` 响应式 HTTP 适配器以及HttpHandler的实现。

items.source: Server-side only alternative to HttpMessageReader.read(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map) with additional context available.
items.translation: 服务器端仅替代方案，提供额外上下文： HttpMessageReader.read(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map)

items.source: Server-side only alternative to HttpMessageReader.readMono(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map) with additional, context available.
items.translation: 服务端唯一的替代方案，具有额外的上下文信息： HttpMessageReader.readMono(ResolvableType, ReactiveHttpInputMessage, Map)

items.source: Server-side only alternative to HttpMessageWriter.write(Publisher, ResolvableType, MediaType, ReactiveHttpOutputMessage, Map) with additional context available.
items.translation: 服务端仅替代方案，提供额外上下文： HttpMessageWriter.write(Publisher, ResolvableType, MediaType, ReactiveHttpOutputMessage, Map)

items.source: Context that holds information for metadata collection regarding reactive HTTP requests observations.
items.translation: 包含有关 `reactive HTTP 请求` 观察的元数据收集信息的上下文。

items.source: Mock extension of AbstractServerHttpResponse for use in tests without an actual server.
items.translation: 用于在没有实际服务器的测试中使用的 `AbstractServerHttpResponse` 的模拟扩展。

items.source: Instrumentation for observing reactive HTTP server applications.
items.translation: 用于观察反应式 HTTP 服务器应用程序的 observing 仪器。

items.source: Reactive support for CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing), based on a common CorsProcessor strategy.
items.translation: 基于通用 CorsProcessor 策略的 CORS（跨域资源共享）响应式支持。

items.source: JSON encoder and decoder support.
items.translation: 支持 JSON 编码器和解码器。

items.source: Provides a foundation for both the reactive client and server subpackages.

items.source: Provides the types that make up Spring's functional web framework for Reactive environments.
items.translation: 提供构成 Spring 用于 Reactive 环境的函数式 Web 框架的类型。

items.source: Core interfaces and classes for Spring's generic, reactive web support.
items.translation: Spring 通用响应式 Web 支持的核心接口和类。
